en.sayed-ali-raza: you were not more entitled than other muhājirūn to conceal and hide the matter.
Your refusing allegiance before entering into it would have been easier than getting out of it after having accepted it.
You have indicated that I killed ‘Uthmān;
then let someone from among the people of Medina who supported neither me nor you decide the matter between me and you.
Then one of us shall face (the command of law) according to (their) involvement.
